meta.title: ESAG Project 3 reference fixture: exp-1 simulation, replicate h = 1, n = 100, six penalized methods at lambda in {1, 16, 128}
meta.generated_by: tmp/p3/scripts/make_fixtures.R + write_json.R (the user's R code is parsed and evaluated verbatim; see SPEC.md section 'Fixtures')
meta.number_format: jsonlite digits=I(17): every double round-trips exactly
meta.matrix_convention: row-major nested arrays; Y[i][j] = R's Y[i+1, j+1]
meta.parameter_vector: par = c(mu[1..6], gamma[1..14]) (R's B for an intercept-only design). gamma groups (1-based in gamma): G1 = 1:2, G2 = 3:5, G3 = 6:9, G4 = 10:14 (B indices 7:8, 9:11, 12:15, 16:20)
meta.data: Y = result[[1]]$Y of LASSO_Comparisons/v2/Regular_LASSO_k100_v2.RData (bitwise identical in all six method files); regenerating with set.seed(1); ESAG(100, mu, gamma) in R 4.6.1 agrees to 7.2e-16
meta.objective: objective_sum_scale = sum_i log f(y_i; mu, gamma) - lambda * P(par) (the R code maximizes this with optim(fnscale = -1)). Paper scale: Q_n = objective_sum_scale / n with lambda_n = lambda / n. P per method in methods[*].penalty_as_coded.
meta.thresholding: par_thresholded = ifelse(|par_untruncated| < 0.01, 0, par_untruncated) (applied to mu too); R's BIC/AIC/SBIC use the log-likelihood at par_thresholded and df = #nonzero entries of par_thresholded (mu included)
meta.start_values: all penalized fits start at truth + 0.1 (oracle start); the unpenalized MLE (adaptive weights) also starts at truth + 0.1
meta.rust_comparison_rule: R's BFGS (numerical gradients) on this nonsmooth objective stops at suboptimal, platform-dependent points (convergence = 0 is only BFGS's reltol test). Compare objective values: a Rust solver must reach objective_sum_scale >= R's value - 1e-6*|value| (maximization) for the identical P; compare coordinates only loosely. Do NOT compare par_thresholded zero patterns exactly.
meta.warning: Several thresholded estimates sit on discontinuity sets of gamma -> V (e.g. aGLASSO lambda=16 zeroes the trailing pair of group 4: loglik drops 539.7 -> 21.0). See METHODOLOGY.md.

unpenalized_mle.note: computed identically in the four adaptive scripts (optim(par = B + 0.1, joint_log_likelihood, fnscale = -1, maxit = 10000, BFGS, default reltol = sqrt(.Machine$double.eps))); not the global MLE: neutral starts reach loglik 544.72 (see SPEC.md)

LASSO.penalty_as_coded: P(B) = sum_{k=7..20} |B_k|  (all 14 gamma entries, weight 1; mu unpenalized). LASSO_v2.R: LASSO_term = sum(abs(B[-(1:d)]))

fits.r_call: r_LASSO_1_BFGS = MLE_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y, X = X, Lambda = 1,      cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS", p_beta0 = TRUE)
r_LASSO_16_BFGS = MLE_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y, X = X,      Lambda = 16, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      p_beta0 = TRUE)
r_LASSO_128_BFGS = MLE_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y, X = X,      Lambda = 128, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      p_beta0 = TRUE)

aLASSO.penalty_as_coded: P(B) = sum_k |W_k B_k|, W = 1/unp$par with W[1:6] = 0, i.e. sum_{k in gamma} |gamma_k| / |gamma_tilde_k|. Weighted_LASSO_v2.R

fits.r_call: r_LASSO_1_BFGS = MLE_weighted_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y,      X = X, Lambda = 1, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      unp_mle = unp_MLE)
r_LASSO_16_BFGS = MLE_weighted_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y,      X = X, Lambda = 16, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      unp_mle = unp_MLE)
r_LASSO_128_BFGS = MLE_weighted_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y,      X = X, Lambda = 128, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      unp_mle = unp_MLE)

RoCLASSO.penalty_as_coded: P(B) = sum_k |W_k^r B_k|, W = |1/unp$par|, W[1:6] = 0, r = max(||mu_tilde|| / ||mu||, 1) with mu = B[1:6] the CURRENT argument and mu_tilde = unp$par[1:6]. RoC_Weighted_LASSO_v2.R

weights.note: effective weight = base^r with r = max(||mu_tilde||/||mu||, 1) recomputed at every evaluation

fits.r_call: r_LASSO_1_BFGS = MLE_RoC_weighted_LASSO(B_start = B + 0.1, Y = Y,      X = X, Lambda = 1, cutoff_threshold = 0.01, opt_method = "BFGS",      unp_mle = unp_MLE)
